title: FAI MCP CLI State v1
description: Validates `~/.frootai/mcp-state.json`, the persistent state file for the `frootai mcp` CLI family. Records the pre-attach roster (areas to attach on next kernel boot) and the most recent health-check snapshot per area.
$comment: License: CC0-1.0. Authored as part of Phase [M4.15] of the FAI MCP Federation Kernel masterplan. Tolerance contract: the CLI reader treats a missing file as an empty state (first-run UX) and defaults absent top-level arrays to `[]`. This schema therefore validates what the file CONTAINS, not whether all top-level keys are present.

version.description: Schema version. v1 is the only supported value today; future versions land via an explicit migrator.

preAttach.description: Names of federated areas to attach eagerly when the next `frootai-mcp` process boots. Order is the operator's append order (not alphabetical) so attach priority is preserved across runs.

lastHealthCheck.description: Most recent `frootai mcp test`/`frootai mcp test --all` snapshot, one entry per area. Upserted by area name (M4.10 + M4.11).
